name: Killer Kage

origin.summary: An event from the 2011 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: Three rounds of front squats, a bike ride, and a monkey-bar traverse.
